name: samatva
description: Stay steady in a hard conversation. Say you're upset, or that a reading or warning left you unsettled, and the samatva router picks one skill: vent (reflections only, no advice), think-it-through (one feeling label, then the friend question), cool-down-close, cold-read-check (claim-by-claim audit of a reading for cold-reading techniques), or before-you-send (holds an angry message until tomorrow). voice-setup derives a style-only voice profile from your own past messages. A skill cannot enforce its rules; the evals in the samatva repo measure whether your host model holds them.
